selection_rationale: The chosen papers directly address core technical and societal aspects of AI LLMs: (0) a comprehensive survey of memory mechanisms in LLMs, (1) safety concerns via jailbreak persuasion, (3) advancing reasoning capabilities through reinforcement learning, (6) a decade-long review of bias in LLM outputs, and (7) a benchmarking study of LLM performance on quantum operation generation. The rejected papers focus on peripheral applications (financial governance, PDF chatbots, medical CTG interpretation) that are less central to a general literature synthesis on AI LLMs.
